Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "Les Misérables", "unit": 60, "heading": "V BÂTONS DANS LES ROUES", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "fr81-u060-r0062", "target": "— Это бесполезно, сударь. Мне нечего продать, кроме колёс для телег. Мы здесь живём в маленьком краю.", "source_sha256": "eafb1e9475fd64966a0a2fe8cc62a794e8db2dc2d8b24b6e08825577dfa7d6ee", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u060-r0062", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "d8ca94fc5c087d8a792a17d57781d134a09b694922d5cb96c4b522041b6291a6"}, {"source_id": "fr81-u060-r0063", "target": "— Не найдётся ли у вас кабриолета, который вы могли бы мне сдать внаём?", "source_sha256": "3d0afc2dbe1964ec5b877de247e94d6764fe360beb590ca571eeb5e8ff3e105e", "target_id": "ru-fr81-u060-r0063", "tag": "prose", "target_sha256": "2969d2cb3d9d23c67f4c1a828b34562389ed4aeff06cb56e3c74df26fdc55ef4"}], "source_language": "French", "part": 1, "book": 7, "chapter": 5, "role": "CHAPTER"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "fr81-u060-r0064", "tag": "prose", "text": "Le maître charron, du premier coup d’œil, avait reconnu que le tilbury était une voiture de louage. Il haussa les épaules.", "sha256": "991c26b1a91cafb8d0664de9364d8cf3071f400dcd40149fdc1202355fe84704", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0065", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Vous les arrangez bien, les cabriolets qu’on vous loue ! j’en aurais un que je ne vous le louerais pas.", "sha256": "34e07f3186de6b60591a30f3fba54584a59a3316c72fbff67b06f8fcef98a3b8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0066", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien, à me vendre ?", "sha256": "ebd100c5df996099c162c472987010c0b7a0668d8a4f5da4e73b4c0e955cafbc", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0067", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je n’en ai pas.", "sha256": "6c7aa457c784d790575e00a9d8101d259e9bf42b3d96e4bd313ebb0de75c37b9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0068", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Quoi ! pas une carriole ? Je ne suis pas difficile, comme vous voyez.", "sha256": "819afbab2cfc0f95636ed9df4a0befc2991fbbb1ec6400ad3fe28cfa58881bc9", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0069", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Nous sommes un petit pays. J’ai bien là sous la remise, ajouta le charron, une vieille calèche qui est à un bourgeois de la ville qui me l’a donnée en garde et qui s’en sert tous les trente-six du mois. Je vous la louerais bien, qu’est-ce que cela me fait ? mais il ne faudrait pas que le bourgeois la vît passer ; et puis, c’est une calèche, il faudrait deux chevaux.", "sha256": "3fd6fd0f8aab30db1621e9322fe0b92e8fa0df229e965b7ddf0e89ef02a339d0", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0070", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Je prendrai deux chevaux de poste.", "sha256": "53c89007f7e042f9bd4a89e1626cac3a8405148ac04e4000bbc970de7b51300a", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0071", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Où va monsieur ?", "sha256": "9b0ac15fb54d9c7056e3cbfca7f06e8de0c39585d704cbd2cc913a7740d903fd", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0072", "tag": "prose", "text": "— À Arras.", "sha256": "087e4f3d7986c3e1fcf149a80f8ba8d7fd13e885abac8bbc81d6d451e814f226", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0073", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Et monsieur veut arriver aujourd’hui ?", "sha256": "84f201095112e31908cfb7ca0312ac708099b729514ca1848e081153c55d631f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0074", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais oui.", "sha256": "89d460959304b6eae0249f48455afa5220f97ac5de5264e9929d7dacc1437fe8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0075", "tag": "prose", "text": "— En prenant des chevaux de poste ?", "sha256": "ba833e962cffed64bb10fc8c54bc03cb535d259a881805e9bb939e23c37c0324", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0076", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Pourquoi pas ?", "sha256": "343fd8e5ef163e40b608bfa4fe702410c418812adfddebff47984a216c70cd83", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0077", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Est-il égal à monsieur d’arriver cette nuit à quatre heures du matin ?", "sha256": "e0d34a86bb82beb2c8a2a27f05a037169a79f3c891250ef6297e67b8f3ab652f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0078", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Non certes.", "sha256": "08453de1f209e26e2fc9cfa398be9c7fb99a8d0b9af14763342dcd0bb9e6f327", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0079", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est que, voyez-vous bien, il y a une chose à dire, en prenant des chevaux de poste… — Monsieur a son passe-port ?", "sha256": "dd5fceb113006c65ed7b66bcc97640b91f5586236cbdb8766cef5f33387c81b4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0080", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0081", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Eh bien, en prenant des chevaux de poste, monsieur n’arrivera pas à Arras avant demain. Nous sommes un chemin de traverse. Les relais sont mal servis, les chevaux sont aux champs. C’est la saison des grandes charrues qui commence, il faut de forts attelages, et l’on prend les chevaux partout, à la poste comme ailleurs. Monsieur attendra au moins trois ou quatre heures à chaque relais. Et puis on va au pas. Il y a beaucoup de côtes à monter.", "sha256": "26de8d3561c31b151ead7ffb940e5c84b8ec1292ff4859cd85d25e536d142557", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0082", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Allons, j’irai à cheval. Dételez le cabriolet. On me vendra bien une selle dans le pays.", "sha256": "04638c90f8d1d786722023cce05144c8fe4bcb36c161b7ab5ecf8a78ec10c269", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0083", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Sans doute. Mais ce cheval-ci endure-t-il la selle ?", "sha256": "f481ce60361bc2cf7159dae50e8de5fbe270bc972b9c5383846c2db175615f21", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0084", "tag": "prose", "text": "— C’est vrai, vous m’y faites penser. Il ne l’endure pas.", "sha256": "e5371aa2e7211654f619666d292de186536f4a4528cc1d5c859fb1fc9bdd29e6", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0085", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Alors…", "sha256": "55a5e8e173fa76749ead3de994655ea8c35cd8325208484a1897d7c0921349ad", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0086", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Mais je trouverai bien dans le village un cheval à louer ?", "sha256": "f3686dddf70aa7ee543aa43b791ce965714b8463536db626a13f785699e3af8b", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0087", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Un cheval pour aller à Arras d’une traite !", "sha256": "b06731a4874d86edb5f35da834d30003c5688ed31f29e335451b1f8b5e757519", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0088", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Oui.", "sha256": "9f4a2e0ce3c8b67038a54bfa044334c55d6f083e8cb634d6147afc7307b16a6f", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0089", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Il faudrait un cheval comme on n’en a pas dans nos endroits. Il faudrait l’acheter d’abord, car on ne vous connaît pas. Mais ni à vendre, ni à louer, ni pour cinq cents francs, ni pour mille, vous ne le trouveriez pas !", "sha256": "9a664a3e14c9b53986fb7b5a18227f11a17634906a23271b7e876c962c4f3def", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0090", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Comment faire ?", "sha256": "98b22d5e9204cb52587c85a1e4cf019cd650a80250f7b1cbf6c515ff9858da70", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0091", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Le mieux, là, en honnête homme, c’est que je raccommode la roue et que vous remettiez votre voyage à demain.", "sha256": "c4425dd538b2bde41583f3ebc440d128d67214103bc8e2cd96fb43ca4c884528", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0092", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Demain il sera trop tard.", "sha256": "f95ae2b2deceab9d38189921ebbc539f07593b8f5e985d4e813aed2c344779f3", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0093", "tag": "prose", "text": "— Dame !", "sha256": "667c2b4d3384f5519f6afa1d79e6d44febfd230c11e3f627876972a3b36a273c", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0094", "tag": "prose", "text": "— N’y a-t-il pas la malle-poste qui va à Arras ? Quand passe-t-elle ?", "sha256": "76027c9afcfaabf07f72d531efbfddadd21dbe5b7bd084aa9558fcd285cfbbb8", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}, {"id": "fr81-u060-r0095", "tag": "prose", "text": "— La nuit prochaine. Les deux malles font le service la nuit, celle qui monte comme celle qui descend.", "sha256": "4783f475dddd35285478026551cee6df30a219e12a222cd5ea70e88c758de1b4", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": []}]}
